evidence.limitation: Actual published plugin, worker, WASM and local font with offscreenRender=false. No default offscreen path, failure recovery, repeated destruction or device acceptance.

limitations: WebKit default frame-clock tests remain failing; explicit event-clock diagnosis is separate.
Offscreen rendering is explicitly disabled for pixel readback.
No native failure recovery, CSP, ratechange, default OffscreenCanvas, devices or sustained heap evidence.
Controlled removeChild uses assertion errors; Event rate payload is not an actual browser structured-clone failure proof.
Historical vendor remains unchanged; candidate repair is later work.
